tools.name: show_pets
tools.description: Show pets to adopt near a place as an interactive view: photos, facts, and a button to meet one at its rescue. Use it when someone wants to look at pets in a place we list (see the server instructions). Apps without interactive views get the same list as text.

near.description: a Taiwan county or township in any language, a US ZIP, Zaragoza, Wien or Fukushima (福島県) (98101, 信義區, 臺北市), or lat,lon; never a street address. Nearest first; an uncovered place gets the nearest pets we hold, marked not nearby

q.description: Words in the person's language: breeds, colors, ages, sizes, sex and places become filters, the rest is full-text ("黑色柴犬")

age.description: Taiwan says only Young or Adult

size.description: Not stated in King County or Vienna

country.description: TW (Taiwan), US (King County WA, Montgomery County MD only), ES (Zaragoza), AT (Vienna, found pets only) or JP (Fukushima Prefecture). Not needed with near

good_with.description: Only pets whose listing says so; rarely stated

lang.description: The person's language: en, es, zh-Hant, zh-Hans, ko, ja, vi, fr, ar, tl (default en)

tools.name: find_pets
tools.description: Search pets to adopt in the places we list (Taiwan, King County WA, Montgomery County MD, Zaragoza, Fukushima Prefecture, and Vienna, found pets only: marked found:true, not adoptable yet; found=exclude leaves them out). Nowhere else yet. Search near a place (nearest first), by species, age, size, sex, breed and color, or by words in any of 10 languages (q). No place and no country = everything we list. Returns names, short facts, distance, the rescue and a link to each listing, plus what q was understood as; an empty answer says what we do list.

country.description: TW (Taiwan), US (King County WA, Montgomery County MD only), ES (Zaragoza), AT (Vienna, found pets only) or JP (Fukushima Prefecture). Not needed with near

region.description: Taiwan county or city, e.g. Taipei City

near.description: a Taiwan county or township in any language, a US ZIP, Zaragoza, Wien or Fukushima (福島県) (98101, 信義區, 臺北市), or lat,lon; never a street address. Nearest first; an uncovered place gets the nearest pets we hold, marked not nearby

place.description: near as structured fields; never a street address

latitude.description: Only with longitude, if the person shared it

area.description: a Taiwan county or township in any language, a US ZIP, Zaragoza, Wien or Fukushima (福島県)

age.description: Taiwan says only Young or Adult

size.description: Not stated in King County or Vienna

good_with.description: Only pets whose listing says so; rarely stated. kids is not offered; if it is passed anyway, the answer lists pets whose listing does not say (good_with_soft, each not_stated). For such wishes prefer search_by_description

q.description: Words in the person's language: breeds, colors, ages, sizes, sex and places become filters, the rest is full-text ("黑色柴犬")

breed.description: Breed name in any language, or Wikidata id

photo.description: good: only pets whose best photo passed our checks; unanalysed pets are left out (only Taiwan's are analysed)

min_photo_px.description: Best photo's longest side, at least, in pixels

found.description: Found pets (Vienna's, announced for their owners first) are included by default, marked found:true, NOT adoptable. exclude = adoptable only. Never call one adoptable

facets.description: Add counts by species, size, age, sex, region

detail.description: find_pets default brief; full = every field of pet.v1

lang.description: The person's language: en, es, zh-Hant, zh-Hans, ko, ja, vi, fr, ar, tl (default en)

tools.name: resolve_place
tools.description: Turn a Taiwan county or township in any language, a US ZIP, Zaragoza, Wien or Fukushima (福島県), or lat,lon into the point find_pets would search around, to confirm with the person before searching. It finds places we list no pets near too (any Japanese prefecture, big cities): find_pets then says so. Positions are rounded to about 1 km and nothing is stored.

near.description: a Taiwan county or township in any language, a US ZIP, Zaragoza, Wien or Fukushima (福島県), or lat,lon

tools.name: find_shelters_near
tools.description: Shelters and rescues near a US ZIP, 'town, ST' or lat,lon that are not on Petnecto yet, nearest first: address, phone, website, their own adoptable-pets page, hours, directions, source and licence. Use it when find_pets finds nothing near the person.

tools.name: resolve_breed
tools.description: Turn a breed name in any language (貴賓犬, pit bull, perro salchicha, 시바견) into Wikidata breed ids, to pass to find_pets as breed or to compare listings across countries.

tools.name: get_pet
tools.description: One pet by Petnecto ID, shelter pet ID, or PetHarbor listing URL: photos, stated facts, adoption fee, the shelter and how to reach it. Lists choices when an ID is shared.

id.description: Petnecto ID, shelter ID, or PetHarbor URL

tools.name: get_rescue
tools.description: One rescue or shelter by id (from a pet's rescue.id): where it is, its adoption page, email and phone.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: The countries and places we hold listings for, and per country how many live pets state each species, age, size, sex, colour and good-with value. Taiwan states no Baby or Senior ages, Vienna no sizes, and few listings anywhere say good-with: check here before suggesting a filter.

tools.name: search_by_description
tools.description: Find pets from wishes in the person's own words, in any language (“a calm small dog good with kids near Seattle”). Use it for wishes listings rarely state, like calm or good with kids: each pet's match says, per wish, stated, inferred (read from its text, with a %) or not_stated, and pets that do not say are left out and counted in not_stated unless include_unknown=true. The answer's understood.chips say what was searched; drop a wrong one with off=[chip id]; a chip noted approx or hint is not a fact about any pet. Found pets (found:true) are not adoptable. Prefer find_pets for structured values.

query.description: What the person wants, in their own words and language, e.g. “a senior dog in Zaragoza”, “a friendly cat near 98101”, “小型犬 台北”

near.description: Where, if it is not in the query: a Taiwan county or township in any language, a US ZIP, Zaragoza, Wien or Fukushima (福島県), or lat,lon

off.description: Chip ids from a previous answer's understood.chips to leave out, e.g. ["good_with:kids"]

include_unknown.description: Also include pets whose listing does not say whether they are good with dogs/cats/kids (they are marked not_stated)

country.description: TW (Taiwan), US (King County WA, Montgomery County MD only), ES (Zaragoza), AT (Vienna, found pets only) or JP (Fukushima Prefecture)

lang.description: The person's language: en, es, zh-Hant, zh-Hans, ko, ja, vi, fr, ar, tl (default en)

tools.name: similar_pets
tools.description: Pets similar to one pet id (from search results): same kind of pet and size, nearest in meaning of their listings. Use it after the person likes one pet.

tools.name: about_this_service
tools.description: Where we list pets (places and counts), where the listings come from, who runs this service, what it keeps, and how a rescue changes or removes its listings.
